rows.reference: THE RESULT IS A GREAT MOBILITY OF THE LABOR EMPLOYED IN PRINTING PERHAPS GREATER THAN IN ANY OTHER EQUALLY WELL DEFINED AND CONSIDERABLE BODY OF WORKMEN
rows.transcript: The result is a great mobility of the labour employed in printing, perhaps greater than in any other equally well-defined and considerable body of workmen.

rows.reference: HOW MAY WE OBTAIN REMISSION OF OUR SINS
rows.transcript: How may we obtain remission of our sins?

rows.reference: TO SUCH PERSONS THESE INDIRECT MODES OF TRAINING CHILDREN IN HABITS OF SUBORDINATION TO THEIR WILL OR RATHER OF YIELDING TO THEIR INFLUENCE ARE SPECIALLY USEFUL
rows.transcript: To such persons, these indirect modes of training children in habits of subordination to their will, or rather of yielding to their influence, are specially useful.

rows.reference: THE WIND NEVER LULLS BUT TO ACQUIRE INCREASED STRENGTH THE VAST BANK OF HEAVY CLOUDS IS A HUGE RESERVOIR OF FEARFUL WINDY GUSTS AND RUSHING STORMS
rows.transcript: The wind never lulls, but to acquire increased strength. The vast bank of heavy clouds is a huge reservoir of fearful, windy gusts and rushing storms.
